note: Small parts as recipes in the genome's vocabulary. {r} is the shape axis radius for controls; the agent writes the element, the recipe says which classes make it one of the system's parts. Decomposed from the sources listed; no source markup is shipped.

atoms.recipe: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-3 text-small font-semibold bg-accent text-on-accent rounded-{r}
atoms.rule: One per screen. A verb and its object ("Book a table"), never "Get started" or "Learn more".

atoms.recipe: inline-flex items-center px-6 py-3 text-small font-semibold text-ink border border-ink rounded-{r}
atoms.rule: The second action, when there is one. No arrow glyph.
Links are underlined ink; colour alone never marks a link.

atoms.recipe: flex items-baseline justify-between py-6; name: text-h3 font-display; links: flex gap-8 text-small
atoms.rule: The name as text, four links at most, the primary button at right.

atoms.recipe: border-t border-line (or border-ink for a strong rule)
atoms.rule: A rule separates; it replaces a box wherever the shape axis says rules.

atoms.recipe: flex flex-col gap-1; value: text-h1 font-display tabular-nums; label: text-small text-muted
atoms.rule: A real number from the brief with its unit. Never a card around it.

atoms.recipe: grid grid-cols-12 gap-x-8 items-baseline py-4 border-t border-line
atoms.rule: Name at left, facts in fixed columns, value right-aligned.

atoms.recipe: w-full border-collapse text-small; th: text-left font-semibold py-3 border-b border-ink; td: py-3 border-b border-line
atoms.rule: Numbers right-aligned, header row ruled in ink, no zebra stripes.

atoms.recipe: inline-flex px-2 py-1 text-label bg-tint text-ink rounded-{r}
atoms.rule: A fact about the thing it is on (a status, a category). Two per screen at most.
Only when the shape axis separates by surfaces. Panels never nest.

atoms.recipe: figure: flex flex-col gap-3; img: w-full aspect-[4/3] object-cover rounded-{R}; figcaption: text-small text-muted
atoms.rule: An image always states what it shows.

atoms.recipe: label: text-small font-semibold; input: w-full px-4 py-3 bg-ground border border-ink rounded-{r} text-body
atoms.rule: Label above, visible border, no placeholder as label.

atoms.recipe: blockquote: text-h2 font-display max-w-[28ch]; cite: text-small text-muted not-italic
atoms.rule: Only words the brief actually gives, with the real name. Otherwise leave it out.

atoms.recipe: grid grid-cols-4 border-t border-line; item: flex flex-col items-center py-3 text-label; current: bg-surface font-semibold
atoms.rule: Words, three to five; the current one marked by fill or weight.

atoms.recipe: border-t border-ink py-12 grid grid-cols-12 gap-x-8 text-small
atoms.rule: Name, address or contact, three or four links, the year. No link farm.
